questions.question:
The ephemeral beauty of the cherry blossom lasts only a few days.

In this sentence, "ephemeral" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: The sentence restates the meaning: it lasts only a few days.

questions.question:
Smartphones have become ubiquitous in the city; almost everyone carries one.

In this sentence, "ubiquitous" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: The restatement "almost everyone carries one" shows the meaning.

questions.question:
Despite the setbacks, she remained sanguine about the outcome.

In this sentence, "sanguine" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: The word contrasts with setbacks, so it is positive.

questions.question:

In this sentence, "pragmatic" is closest in meaning to
questions.explanation: The contrast with elegance shows a practical outlook.

questions.question:

questions.question:
